title: Trick Shot
description: Find the highest arc and count all velocities that land a probe in a target area.
writeup:
## Approach

Simulate every plausible initial velocity `(vx, vy)` and check whether the probe passes through the target area. The x-velocity decreases by 1 each step (drag), and y-velocity decreases by 1 (gravity).

## Part 1

The highest trajectory uses the largest vy that still hits the target. For each candidate, track the maximum y reached during the arc. The answer is the global maximum across all hitting trajectories.

## Part 2

Count every distinct `(vx, vy)` pair whose trajectory passes through the target at any step. The search bounds are `vx ∈ [0, x_max]` (larger vx overshoots on step 1) and `vy ∈ [y_min, -y_min]` (larger vy overshoots downward after the apex).
